svg.aria-label: Bonus level, a product from my own business: a gaming café ERP. I ran the cafés this was built for, so the requirements came from the floor: one session and billing engine for every table and console, a live floor view, customers and memberships, a wallet, bookings without clashes, a food and beverage counter, and separate apps for the owner and for customers. Built with NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, React, Socket.IO and Docker.
